title: Golden {p} Scramble with {v}
steps: Crumble in the pressed {p} with your hands. Sprinkle with the {spice}, a spoonful of nutritional yeast and a pinch of salt, and add a splash of plant milk.
Stir gently 6 to 8 minutes, until {doneness} and the moisture has cooked off into a soft scramble.
Serve with the {v}, the {s} and the {sauce}.
tip: Add extra vegetables and keep to one slice of toast.
